brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Seamline, the open-source command-line tool in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: precise, trustworthy, developer-native; it must work in a terminal-heavy README, as a GitHub avatar and on a small docs site. No database cylinders, no elephants, no generic terminal prompt. Web and GitHub only.

claim.notes: Üç yönden hiçbiri kalite kapısını geçemedi (en iyi stitched-join ortalama 5,92, distinctiveness ve memorability 5), bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve gallery çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Split S
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 letter S with a cut; s2 Z/S glyph sliced by a slash; s3 generic split tile or Yin-Yang-like pill. All are the name's initial with a split/offset (most common monogram device) or a stock tile (88%). Different move: leave the letter entirely; find a non-letter form for a seam or join, e.g. two interlocking shapes forming a single closed silhouette, with color doing the split.

concepts.title: Step Seam
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 a house-pentagon over a shield/pennant, or a split gem; s7 a big square with a small square/pill stuck on (app tile, two windows); s8 two triangles tip to tip, an hourglass or sort/expand toggle. All three are a solid shape sliced and offset, the same move as stitched-join s5 (split disc, shifted halves), and the step meant by the caption is lost: one lateral shift reads as nothing. s6 and s8 also lose the shape (hexagon and diamond are stock, 72% and 66% similar) and drift toward hourglass/shield; s7 is a generic square (82% similar) with a fault line nobody sees at 16 px. Nothing here earns distinctiveness 7. Different move: drop the sliced solid. Go back to s1/s3/s5 territory, where the step is the silhouette itself (a continuous stepped contour or staircase edge that is one ownable shape, with the lit amber step as the only accent), not a cut through a stock shape.

concepts.title: Stitched Join
readsAs: two offset panels with a twisted rope or DNA helix between
a coil spring or bolt thread
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 pause/domino colon; s2 chain link or B/8; s3 dice or slashed tile (87% stock); s4 menu/text-align bars; s5 split disc with pill, toggle-like. Keep s5: round, solid, avatar-friendly, offset halves plus one orange pin is the join idea. Fix: widen the vertical slide offset so it is not a no-entry/minus sign, make the pill pin overlap both halves visibly, thicken for 16px, and drop the white pill outline gap if it reads as a hole.
